SPECIFICATION FOR BASKET STRAINERS FOR FIRE FIGHTING PURPOSES ( CYLINDRICAL TYPE )

( First Revision )
0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 24 February 1984, after the draft finalized by the Fire Fighting Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council. 0.2 The basket strainers is used with the metal strainer of cylindrical type which is covered in IS : 907-1984". This standard covers requirements so as to guide the manufacturers as well as the users for the manufacture and checking the requirements for the proper specifications. This standard was first published in 1966. This revision has been prepared so as to give more details in respect to dimensions. 0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-19607. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value
in this standard.

lays down requirements regarding material, sizes, 1.1 This standard shape and dimensions and construction of basket strainer (cylindrical type) for fire fighting purposes.

IS:3582-1984 2. TERMINOLOGY 2.0 For.the apply. purpose of this standard, the following definitions shall

2.1 Stakes - Rods which form upright in the sides of the basket to give proper shape to the basket strainer. 2.2 Rod BorderRods used to make border of basket strainer.

2.3 Wales - A constructional member, made of a strong material ( as timber or steel ) used for bracing other members of basket strainer. 2.4 Runner 3. MATERIALS 3.1 Cane - The cane used for the manufacture of the strainer shall be clean free from any kind of decay ( rot ), insect attack including ravages by insects, cuts and leaf sheaths. The cane shall be capable of in the air dry conditions of being bent to a circle of a diameter of 15 cm without showing any signs of fracture. 3.2 The canvas for the sleeves shall be of variety No. 3 as specified in IS : 1424-1977". 3.3 The sail eyelets and rings shall be manufactured from aluminium alloy conforming to IS Designation No. 4450 of IS : 617-19757. 3.4 The cord used for eyelets shall be of nylon of breaking strength not less than 100 kgf. 4. SIZES 4.1 Basket strainers shall be of the following 75, 100, 125 and 140 mm. 5. SHAPE AND DIMENSIONS sizes: A rod which is worked in randing.

5.1 The shape of basket strainers shall be as shown in Fig. 1 and the dimensions shall conform to those given in Fig. 1 and Table 1. *Specification for cotton canvas ( second revision ). fsnecification for aluminium and aluminium alloy ingots and castings engineering purposes ( second rerisipn ). 4

6. CONSTRUCTION 6.1 Baskets ( see Fig. 1 ) - The strainer basket shall have six bottom sticks. The 75 mm size shall have 19 stakes, the 100 mm size 21 stakes, and 125 mm and 140 mm sizes 23 stakes with three rod borders. There shall be three rounds of upsetting, the first round should have four rods. There shall be two double body wales at the centre of the 75 mm and 100 mm sizes and four rounds of three rod waling at the centre of the 125 mm and 140 mm sizes. There shall be two rounds of waling under the border in each size with four runners forming stakes.

NOTE - The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution (Certification Marks) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The IS1 Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to complv with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. The IS1 marked products are also continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions, under which a licence for the use of the IS1 Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.
